item.title: US ‘coming after’ Iran beyond Strait of Hormuz blockade, ex-CENTCOM admiral warns
item.summary: A former top CENTCOM commander warns the U.S.' Strait of Hormuz blockade is just the first step in coming after Iran's regime, praising President Trump.

item.title: Trump warns China of 'staggering' 50% tariff if caught supplying military aid to Iran
item.summary: President Trump warns China could face 50% tariffs if caught supplying military aid to Iran as a sweeping Strait of Hormuz blockade takes effect.

item.title: Could Somaliland base emerge as US foothold against Iran, Houthis in key sea lanes?
item.summary: Somaliland is offering the U.S. a Red Sea port and air base at Berbera as Iran pushes Houthis to disrupt shipping through the Bab-el-Mandeb strait.

item.title: AI is now powering cyberattacks, Microsoft warns
item.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence says cybercriminals are using AI across nearly every stage of a cyberattack to move faster and scale their operations.

item.title: Judge dismisses Trump's $10B defamation lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal over Epstein story
item.summary: A federal judge dismissed President Trump's $10 billion defamation lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal over a story about his alleged ties to Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Trump's meme depicting himself as Jesus Christ draws backlash from allies
item.summary: President Trump's AI-generated image depicting himself as Jesus Christ irked Americans on both sides of the aisle, with many calling the post blasphemous.

item.title: Gubernatorial candidate vows to pardon cop convicted of manslaughter in death of fleeing suspect
item.summary: NYPD Sgt. Erik Duran was convicted of manslaughter after throwing a cooler at a fleeing suspect. GOP gubernatorial candidate Bruce Blakeman vows pardon.

item.title: Bishop Barron says Trump ‘owes the pope an apology’
item.summary: Bishop Robert Barron says Trump owes Pope Leo XIV an apology after the president posted scathing remarks on Truth Social criticizing the new pontiff.

item.title: Country star Ella Langley says 'very scary' Alabama church haunted house led to her getting 'saved again'
item.summary: Ella Langley opens up about her Southern Baptist upbringing in small-town Alabama, recalling church judgment houses and singing hymnals as a child.

item.title: The simple tax habit that could save you thousands over your lifetime
item.summary: Filing your taxes early can mean faster refunds, fewer errors and better fraud protection, according to Jackson Hewitt's chief tax officer Mark Steber.
